conclusions: The v1.6.1 T1-T2 error was reproduced on the original upload.
A connected candidate on T2 contained both centrum and facet landmarks; greedy component pairing consumed the shared region.
Landmark-guided geodesic partitions recover distinct regions without expanding the original opposing-surface mask.
Eight initially incomplete joints recover. Joint 107 succeeds after other affected neighboring contacts are recovered.
All 112 originally complete contact boundaries and anchors remain unchanged.
Ouroborus transformation matrices are bitwise identical to the validated v1.6.1 output.
The fitting objective, dense penetration helper, symmetry code, penetration limits and coverage QC are unchanged.
limitations: Successful recovery and export are distinct from anatomical acceptance. Inspect the recorded review reasons.
Coverage is sampled surface support; the 10% presence threshold does not replace the 60% QC target.
Rhineura has four joints exceeding penetration tolerance and 27 joints with at least one contact below 10% support; it is not accepted for downstream neutral-pose analyses.
The full-column preview also shows substantial sagittal coiling; these posed files are diagnostic results.
Unverified signs cannot certify absence of penetration on defective or open meshes.
Draco and Bipes were not rerun for v1.6.2; their prior v1.6.1 validation remains separate.
The Ouroborus input used here was recovered loaded geometry as documented in v1.6.1, not the lost original upload.
